nodes.text: JUST IN: China experiences a surge in respiratory illnesses, including HMPV, five years after the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. Reports suggest hospitals and crematories are overwhelmed, with social media posts showing overcrowded facilities.

nodes.author: Akhi_l__
nodes.text:
🦠 Multiple viruses are reportedly circulating, including HMPV, influenza A, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and COVID-19.
Children's hospitals are under strain due to a sharp increase in pneumonia and "white lung" cases.

China's National Disease Control and Prevention Administration (NCDPA) launches a pilot monitoring system for pneumonia of unknown origin to track and respond to the surge, particularly during winter.
New protocols require labs to report infections, with disease control agencies verifying and managing cases.

nodes.text:
🗣️ NCDPA official Kan Biao: Respiratory infections are expected to increase throughout winter and spring, but the total number of cases this year is projected to be lower than in 2024.
